findings.title: Constructors have nondeterministic identity and time defaults
findings.evidence: ProtectionIntent.intent_id/created_at, TradePlan.created_at, StopPolicy.created_at, Order.created_at, and generated validation/action/request IDs use uuid7 or datetime.now(). Two otherwise equivalent TradePlan constructions with generated ProtectionIntent identity produce different plan_hash values. Replay callers must know to override every default; no canonical hydrate/replay constructor or test proves this.
findings.reproduction: UV_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/fao-uv-cache uv run python - <<'PY' ... construct two equivalent TradePlans while omitting ProtectionIntent intent_id ... print(a.plan_hash != b.plan_hash) ... PY => True
findings.required_fix: Make persisted/replay construction explicit and deterministic (canonical hydrate/deserialize with required IDs/timestamps, or deterministic IDs/times); add byte/hash-identical replay tests for every V2 contract and generated protection artifact.

findings.title: Cross-object references are not validated against real referenced facts
findings.evidence: The contracts validate that some fields are EntityId values and that a few namespaces match, but do not bind IDs plus versions/hashes to the referenced object. LedgerEntry.event_ref accepts a trade_plan ID; SimulationAutonomyMandate and MandateScope accept wrong namespaces; RiskDecision.plan_hash is optional; ProtectionMandate and ExecutionPlan can carry non-existent or unrelated IDs. Existing tests only exercise type/namespace checks and do not hydrate a graph or reject these cases.
findings.reproduction: UV_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/fao-uv-cache uv run python - <<'PY' ... LedgerEntry(..., event_ref=EntityId.new('trade_plan'), ...) ... PY => object is accepted; RiskDecision(..., plan_hash=None) => accepted; Mandate with EntityId.new('wrong') => accepted.
findings.required_fix: Add explicit reference contracts/resolvers (or owner-issued typed refs) that verify target namespace, target version and target content hash, and fail closed when target is absent/mismatched. Expand tests to construct invalid reference graphs, not only malformed scalar IDs.

findings.title: Protection trigger requests are stale for versioned positions and mislabel trailing stops
findings.evidence: ProtectionTriggerEvaluator._request hardcodes expected_position_version=1. A lot at version 7 therefore yields a request that ProtectionValidator marks STALE when validated against the lot's current version. trailing_stop delegates to price_stop, so a trailing trigger is emitted as INITIAL_STOP rather than TRAILING_STOP.
findings.reproduction: UV_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/fao-uv-cache uv run python - <<'PY' ... lot=PositionLot(..., version=7); r=ProtectionTriggerEvaluator().price_stop(...); print(r.expected_position_version) => 1; validator outcome => STALE; trailing_stop(...).trigger => INITIAL_STOP ... PY
findings.required_fix: Populate expected_position_version from lot.version and preserve the requested trigger kind in each evaluator path; add tests for non-1 versions and all six trigger kinds.

findings.title: TradePlan accepts an expiry that is already before creation
findings.evidence: TradePlan validates that expires_at is a RecordedAt but never requires expires_at > created_at. A plan with created_at=2026-01-01T00:00:20Z and expires_at=2026-01-01T00:00:10Z is constructed successfully, undermining deterministic lifecycle/replay boundaries.
findings.reproduction: UV_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/fao-uv-cache uv run python - <<'PY' ... TradePlan(..., created_at=at(20), expires_at=at(10)) ... PY => past expiry accepted.
findings.required_fix: Reject expiry at or before creation and add boundary tests; apply the same invariant to all bounded authorization and execution contracts where relevant.

findings.title: Receipt consumption is not atomic with reservation consumption
findings.evidence: TradePlanSubmitter.consume_authorized_receipt first calls receipt_registry.consume, which irreversibly marks the receipt used, and only then calls ledger.consume. If ledger consumption returns None or raises, the method returns False after the receipt side effect, so a retry cannot recover and receipt/reservation state diverges. The method accepts both dependencies as Any and has no rollback or transaction boundary.
findings.reproduction: UV_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/fao-uv-cache uv run python - <<'PY' ... fake receipt registry consume returns True; fake reservation has reservation_id; fake ledger.consume returns None ... PY => method returns False after receipt consume has already succeeded.
findings.required_fix: Use one atomic owner transaction or a compensating prepare/commit protocol that cannot mark a receipt consumed unless reservation consumption commits; add failure-injection and retry tests.

findings.title: Submission does not bind receipt quantity/action or recheck plan lifecycle
findings.evidence: TradePlanSubmitter.submit checks plan/risk/protection/reservation identifiers but never calls validate_plan and never compares receipt.action/receipt.quantity with the risk decision or plan. It can therefore create an ExecutionPlan for a DRAFT/expired or otherwise non-submittable plan, and can use a receipt carrying quantity 1 while emitting risk.approved_quantity 2 when the reservation permits 2.
findings.reproduction: Static path inspection of decision/submission.py: submit has no plan.status/plan.expires_at check and only compares receipt plan identity/hash; quantity check is risk.approved_quantity <= reservation.quantity. Add a contract test with mismatched receipt quantity or expired status and observe execution creation.
findings.required_fix: Invoke the complete deterministic plan validator in submit and require exact receipt action/quantity/scope/origin equality with risk, protection, reservation, and plan before creating ExecutionPlan.

findings.title: PlanApprovalRegistry replay compares the consumed hash to the original grant hash
findings.evidence: On a second consume call, PlanApprovalRegistry.consume enters its existing-record branch and checks approval.authorization_hash == granted_hash. The returned CONSUMED approval necessarily hashes different status/version fields from the original GRANTED approval, so an exact replay of the same consumed approval is rejected instead of returning the original basis.
findings.reproduction: Read decision/autonomy_contracts.py PlanApprovalRegistry.consume existing branch: `if approval.authorization_hash != granted_hash: return approval, None`; first call stores granted authorization_hash and returns a version-incremented CONSUMED approval. Replaying that returned object therefore fails this comparison.
findings.required_fix: Compare approval.granted_authorization_hash (or persist the immutable grant hash explicitly) in the replay branch and add an exact same-command replay test.

findings.title: Owner modules are compatibility aliases, not owner-defined contracts
findings.evidence: portfolio_risk/contracts.py, execution_simulation/contracts.py, and accounting_settlement/contracts.py only import classes from decision.trade_contracts. Runtime inspection reports RiskDecision.__module__, Order.__module__, and PositionLot.__module__ all as futures_agent_os.decision.trade_contracts. This leaves Decision as the canonical definition despite comments claiming owner context ownership; no test enforces owner import/definition boundaries.
findings.reproduction: UV_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/fao-uv-cache uv run python - <<'PY' ... import futures_agent_os.portfolio_risk as pr, futures_agent_os.execution_simulation as ex, futures_agent_os.accounting_settlement as ac; print(pr.RiskDecision.__module__, ex.Order.__module__, ac.PositionLot.__module__) ... PY => all decision.trade_contracts.
findings.required_fix: Move definitions (or introduce owner-owned canonical contract modules) and make decision exports explicit compatibility shims with tests proving owner ownership and no reverse authority dependency.

finite_fix_list: Define deterministic hydrate/replay semantics and remove or constrain uuid7/now defaults for persisted V2 objects.
Implement real cross-object target/version/hash binding and invalid graph tests.
Fix protection trigger version propagation and trigger-kind labeling.
Reject TradePlan expiry at or before creation.
Make receipt and reservation consumption one atomic operation with failure/retry coverage.
Resolve owner canonical-definition versus compatibility-reexport boundary and test it.
